name: PriceBoard Lite
author: lessizoli

sections.description:
PriceBoard Lite is a fast and efficient pricing dashboard for WooCommerce, specifically designed for Simple Products.
It allows shop owners to manage product prices and sale prices from a single, intuitive interface[cite: 2].
The plugin features a high-performance live search that lets you find products by SKU or name instantly, without page reloads[cite: 3].

Key Features:
* Live Search: Find simple products by SKU or name in milliseconds[cite: 4].
* Bulk-like Interface: Edit multiple simple product prices on one screen[cite: 5].
* Internationalization: Full support for multiple languages[cite: 7].

Looking for Variable Product support?
The Lite version focuses on Simple Products. For Variable Product support and advanced features, please check out the PRO version at priceboard.hu.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the priceboard-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory[cite: 8].
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress[cite: 9].
  3. Access the dashboard via the ‘PriceBoard’ menu item in your WordPress admin[cite: 10].
sections.faq:
Does it support product variations?

Simple product pricing is fully available in this Lite version[cite: 11]. Variable products and their variations are visible in the list, but editing them requires the PRO version.

Is the search real-time?

Yes, the search uses AJAX to filter your products as you type[cite: 13].
sections.changelog:
1.3.5

  • Security: Implemented proper script enqueuing using wp_enqueue_script and wp_add_inline_script for better compatibility.
  • Compliance: Updated “Tested up to” tag to 6.9 to ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress core.
  • Documentation: Added missing Short Description and synchronized Stable Tag.

1.3.4

  • Compliance update: Removed built-in license check and restricted functionality.
  • Fixed output buffering issue in AJAX search.
  • Removed external update mechanism to comply with WordPress.org guidelines.

1.3.2

  • Added multi-language support (HU, EN, DE, PL, CS, RO, HR)[cite: 15].
  • Added custom SVG menu icon.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
